Why You Should Register on Bet261 and Create an Account?

Bet261 is a top bookmaker in Madagascar. It has all attributes to deliver excellent service for the local market. The sportsbook, the cashier section and the platform overall are on point.

Play Here!

Bet261 has a classic sportsbook that covers ten major sports like football, basketball, tennis etc. The markets offered for live and pre-match betting come with one of the highest odds in the region. Horse and chariot racing are included in Bet261 services, where you can also find virtual sports, casinos and lottery.

Bet261 is completely secure to register and play with as it is licensed and regulated under the Madagascar law. License information can be found in the “A propos” section of the quick links.

The website is built intelligently, as it looks good and works as it should. You can find helpful betting tips that will help you navigate through the website and place bets.

Bet261 Promotions – Sports Betting Sign-Up Bonus

Bet261 has a decent promo section, and accumulator and cashback bonuses are available for regular customers. Unfortunately, there is no welcome bonus offered, and we hope they will add it to their promo section soon.

Bet261 Register: Online Account Creation Quick Guide

Bet261 has a standard and easy registration form, which is also quick to complete. We have four basic steps describing the overall process.

  • Open the website
  • Go to the registration page
  • Enter your details
  • Confirm the registration

To make things more precise, we made a more detailed map for you in the next paragraph. Check the full description of the account creation process below.

How to Easily Register on Bet261 Sportsbook Online – All You Need to Know to Sign Up & Make a Bet

We have an account creation quick guide above on this topic, but if you are new to betting sites, we made a more detailed map describing the registration process.

Step 1: Open the Bet261 website

Open the Bet261 website

In your address bar, type Bet261.mg or go through one of the partner links.

Step 2: Go to the registration page.

Go to the registration page

On the website, you will see the “Register” button in the top right corner of the page.

Step 3: Enter your details

Enter your details

Enter your name, username and phone number, and create a new password. Below read the terms and conditions, tick the boxes to agree, confirm your age and click “inscription.”

Step 4: Verify and complete

Verify and complete

You will receive an SMS confirmation code. Enter the code in the corresponding field and click “Valider.” Now your registration is complete, and your account is ready. You can deposit and start playing already.

To place a bet, go to the sports section by choosing Sports from the navigation bar. Bet261 has a typical design with a left-side menu containing sports, leagues, countries and events. Choose your markets, which will appear in your betslip on the right side. You can add more markets and create an express ticket. You can also select the bet amount and track odds on the betslip.

Payment Methods For Malagasy Customers On Bet261 Sportsbook

Bet261 has a good cashier section that is very well suited to the local market and is accessible for Madagascar residents.

Users can make payments from the local shops or choose from several online deposit options: M-Vola, Orange Money and Airtel.

Payment limits, processing times or transaction fees are not specified on the website. Only Orange money payment limits are mentioned, with 1000 Ar as a minimum and 10.000.000 Ar as a maximum. You can find local shops listed in the FAQ section.

Bookmaker Ratings Verdict

Bet261 is a good bookmaker designed for Madagascar’s betting market. They offer a great sportsbook, nice promos and a well-functioning platform. Adding a welcome offer will be awesome, so we hope they do it sooner. Registration is quick and easy, and the account is verified through the phone number. Payments are accessible. We recommend this bookmaker as one of the best in Madagascar.

FAQ about Bet261 Register & Account Options

Can I immediately proceed and deposit after registering my account?

After the registration is complete, deposits are available instantly, but we recommend reading the rules and other nuances of the bookmaker.

How Long Does it Take to Register a Bet261 Account?

Creating an account doesn’t take much and a couple of minutes is enough.

Using a Bet261 Account when Traveling Abroad is Possible?

Bet261’s website is available and exploitable worldwide unless a specific country blocks it or betting is illegal.

Will I be charged by Bet261 to register a new account?

No fees will be charged for signing up for Bet261.

If I already have a Bet261 account, can I register a new account from the mobile app?

You can not have more than one account, as the website policy allows a single account per customer.

Do I need to register with Bet261 to get the app?

There is no need to register to get the app. You need to go to the mobile version of the website, click the dropdown menu on the left, and you will see the links to download Android and iOS apps.

What bonus code should I use when registering to get the Bet261 welcome bonus?

Bet261 doesn’t offer a welcome bonus currently.

How to Contact the Bet261 Support Team to get help?

Bet261 customer support team can be reached via toll-free numbers: 0343080006 and 0323203535.

How to reset the password to your account?

In the login window, click “forgot your password”, enter your phone and receive a code via SMS. Enter the code and change the password.

“Your account has been suspended” whenever I try to log in – what should I do?

You need to ensure that you didn’t violate the website’s rules, and if that’s not the case, contact the customer support team for help.

How to Change Personal Information After Registration?

Personal information is not needed while registering. The only data is the phone number, and it can be changed only by the administration.

Can I temporarily suspend my account?

Temporary suspension can be done by the administration after you send a request to them.

How Can I Permanently Close My Bet261 Account?

Bet261 account deletion is possible only by requesting customer support.
